user_query: I'm developing a language learning app and I need a translation tool that can provide audio pronunciations of translated words. Is there an API that offers audio pronunciations for translated words? Additionally, I would like to gather information about the languages supported by Microsoft Translator Text API for potential integration into my app.

TaskList.description: Research and identify an API that provides audio pronunciations for translated words.
Gather information about the languages supported by Microsoft Translator Text API.
Integrate the chosen audio pronunciation API into the language learning app.
Implement the language support from the Microsoft Translator Text API into the app.
